prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a surreal, ethereal portrait of a human figure with long dark hair, their face and upper torso rendered as a transparent, crystalline skull and neck. The skull glows with an inner, otherworldly light, casting soft reflections and refracted highlights throughout the translucent bone structure. Delicate, white flower petals and small blossoms float gently around the figure, some caught in midair, enhancing the dreamlike atmosphere. The background is softly blurred with a cool, pale color palette of mint greens, icy blues, and hints of white, evoking a sense of calm and mystery. The lighting is luminous and diffuse, with shimmering particles and bokeh effects adding depth and a magical quality. The composition is close-up and intimate, with a shallow depth of field focusing on the intricate details of the crystalline skull, while the rest of the scene fades into a gentle haze. The overall style is cinematic and hyperreal, blending elements of fantasy and photorealism to create a hauntingly beautiful, almost spectral image.
